name: json_literals
description: Translate Python boolean and missing-value literals into JSON lowercase literals; matched control serializes strings in the same object format.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[]; control=[]
keys=['active','ready','enabled','valid','visible','cached','result','value','answer','flag','status','entry']
for i in range(96):
 k=keys[i%len(keys)]; v=[True,False,None][(i//len(keys)+i)%3]
 prefix='Convert this Python dictionary to JSON. Output only the JSON object.\nPython: '
 p=prefix+repr({k:v})+'\nJSON: {"'+k+'":'
 items.append({'prompt':p,'answer':' '+json.dumps(v)+'}'})
 s=random.choice(['apple','blue','small','plain','open','warm'])
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+repr({k:s})+'\nJSON: {"'+k+'":','answer':' '+json.dumps(s)+'}'})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
